verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד הֲכִ֣י יֶשׁ־ ע֔וֹד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹתַ֖ר לְבֵ֣ית שָׁא֑וּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה עִמּוֹ֙ חֶ֔סֶד בַּעֲב֖וּר יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ hă·ḵî yeš- ‘ō·wḏ ’ă·šer nō·w·ṯar lə·ḇêṯ šā·’ūl wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ‘im·mōw ḥe·seḏ ba·‘ă·ḇūr yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: Then David . . . asked Is there . . . anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan
verses.literalPt: E DISSE Davi: Há ainda alguém que tenha ficado da casa de Saul, para que lhe faça benevolência por amor de Jônatas?

verses.original: וּלְבֵ֨ית שָׁא֥וּל עֶ֙בֶד֙ וּשְׁמ֣וֹ צִיבָ֔א וַיִּקְרְאוּ־ ל֖וֹ אֶל־ דָּוִ֑ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ אֵלָ֛יו הַאַתָּ֥ה צִיבָ֖א וַיֹּ֥אמֶר עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇêṯ šā·’ūl ‘e·ḇeḏ ū·šə·mōw ṣî·ḇā way·yiq·rə·’ū- lōw ’el- dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’ê·lāw ha·’at·tāh ṣî·ḇā way·yō·mer ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: And there was a servant of the house of Saul named Ziba They summoned him to David and the king inquired . . . Are you Ziba I am your servant he replied
verses.literalPt: E havia um servo na casa de Saul cujo nome era Ziba; e o chamaram à presença de Davi. Disse-lhe o rei: És tu Ziba? E ele disse: Servo teu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הַאֶ֨פֶס ע֥וֹד אִישׁ֙ לְבֵ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה עִמּ֖וֹ חֶ֣סֶד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ ע֛וֹד בֵּ֥ן לִיהוֹנָתָ֖ן נְכֵ֥ה רַגְלָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ha·’e·p̄es ‘ō·wḏ ’îš lə·ḇêṯ šā·’ūl wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ‘im·mōw ḥe·seḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer ṣî·ḇā ’el- ham·me·leḵ ‘ō·wḏ bên lî·hō·w·nā·ṯān nə·ḵêh raḡ·lā·yim
verses.literal: So the king . . . asked Is there anyone left of the house of Saul to whom I can show the kindness of God Ziba answered - There is still Jonathan’s son who is lame in both feet
verses.literalPt: E disse o rei: Não há ainda alguém da casa de Saul para que eu use com ele da benevolência de Deus? Então disse Ziba ao rei: Ainda há um filho de Jônatas, aleijado de ambos os pés.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֵיפֹ֣ה ה֑וּא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּה־ ה֗וּא בֵּ֛ית מָכִ֥יר בֶּן־ עַמִּיאֵ֖ל בְּל֥וֹ דְבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer- lōw ham·me·leḵ ’ê·p̄ōh hū way·yō·mer ṣî·ḇā ’el- ham·me·leḵ hin·nêh- hū bêṯ mā·ḵîr ben- ‘am·mî·’êl bə·lōw ḏə·ḇār
verses.literal: Where is he replied the king And Ziba . . . said Indeed he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o rei: Onde está? E disse Ziba ao rei: Eis que está em casa de Maquir, filho de Amiel, em Lo-Debar.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִבֵּ֛ית מָכִ֥יר בֶּן־ עַמִּיאֵ֖ל מִלּ֥וֹ דְבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū mib·bêṯ mā·ḵîr ben- ‘am·mî·’êl mil·lōw ḏə·ḇār
verses.literal: So King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel in Lo-debar
verses.literalPt: Então mandou o rei Davi, e o tomou da casa de Maquir, filho de Amiel, de Lo-Debar.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹא מְפִיבֹ֨שֶׁת בֶּן־ יְהוֹנָתָ֤ן בֶּן־ שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ פָּנָ֖יו וַיִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ מְפִיבֹ֔שֶׁת וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mə·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ ben- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·’ūl ’el- dā·wiḏ way·yip·pōl ‘al- pā·nāw way·yiš·tā·ḥū way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ mə·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ way·yō·mer hin·nêh ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan the son of Saul came to David he fell facedown . . . . . . in reverence Then David said Mephibosheth I am your servant he replied . . .
verses.literalPt: E Mefibosete, filho de Jônatas, o filho de Saul, veio a Davi, e se prostrou com o rosto por terra e inclinou-se; e disse Davi: Mefibosete! E ele disse: Eis aqui teu servo.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ דָוִ֜ד אַל־ תִּירָ֗א כִּ֣י עָשֹׂה֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה עִמְּךָ֥ חֶ֙סֶד֙ בַּֽעֲבוּר֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן אָבִ֔יךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֣י לְךָ֔ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ שְׂדֵ֖ה שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַתָּ֗ה תֹּ֥אכַל לֶ֛חֶם עַל־ שֻׁלְחָנִ֖י תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ḏā·wiḏ ’al- tî·rā kî ‘ā·śōh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ‘im·mə·ḵā ḥe·seḏ ba·‘ă·ḇūr yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî lə·ḵā ’eṯ- kāl- śə·ḏêh šā·’ūl ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’at·tāh tō·ḵal le·ḥem ‘al- šul·ḥā·nî tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Do not be afraid said David for surely I will show . . . you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul and you will always eat . . . at my table
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe Davi: Não temas, porque decerto usarei contigo de benevolência por amor de Jônatas, teu pai, e te restituirei todas as terras de Saul, teu pai, e tu sempre comerás pão à minha mesa.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁתַּ֕חוּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֣י פָנִ֔יתָ אֶל־ הַכֶּ֥לֶב הַמֵּ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּמֽוֹנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ta·ḥū way·yō·mer meh ‘aḇ·de·ḵā kî p̄ā·nî·ṯā ’el- hak·ke·leḇ ham·mêṯ ’ă·šer kā·mō·w·nî
verses.literal: Mephibosheth bowed down and said What is your servant that you should show regard for a dead dog like me
verses.literalPt: Então se inclinou, e disse: Quem é teu servo, para teres olhado para um cão morto tal como eu?

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל־ צִיבָ֛א נַ֥עַר שָׁא֖וּל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה לְשָׁאוּל֙ וּלְכָל־ בֵּית֔וֹ נָתַ֖תִּי לְבֶן־ אֲדֹנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ham·me·leḵ ’el- ṣî·ḇā na·‘ar šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kōl ’ă·šer hā·yāh lə·šā·’ūl ū·lə·ḵāl- bê·ṯōw nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḇen- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said . . . to him I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house
verses.literalPt: Então chamou Davi a Ziba, moço de Saul, e disse-lhe: Tudo o que pertencia a Saul, e a toda a sua casa, tenho dado ao filho de teu senhor.

verses.original: וְעָבַ֣דְתָּ לּ֣וֹ אֶֽת־ הָאֲדָמָ֡ה אַתָּה֩ וּבָנֶ֨יךָ וַעֲבָדֶ֜יךָ וְהֵבֵ֗אתָ וְהָיָ֨ה לְבֶן־ אֲדֹנֶ֤יךָ לֶּ֙חֶם֙ וַאֲכָל֔וֹ וּמְפִיבֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בֶּן־ אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ יֹאכַ֥ל תָּמִ֛יד לֶ֖חֶם עַל־ שֻׁלְחָנִ֑י וּלְצִיבָ֗א חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר בָּנִ֖ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā lōw ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā wə·hā·yāh lə·ḇen- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā le·ḥem wa·’ă·ḵā·lōw ū·mə·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ ben- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā yō·ḵal tā·mîḏ le·ḥem ‘al- šul·ḥā·nî ū·lə·ṣî·ḇā ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār bā·nîm wə·‘eś·rîm ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat But Mephibosheth your master’s grandson is always . . . to eat at my table Now Ziba had fifteen . . . sons and twenty servants
verses.literalPt: Trabalhar-lhe-ás, pois, a terra, tu e teus filhos, e teus servos, e recolherás os frutos, para que o filho de teu senhor tenha pão para comer; mas Mefibosete, filho de teu senhor, sempre comerá pão à minha mesa. E tinha Ziba quinze filhos e vinte servos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֲדֹנִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶת־ עַבְדּ֔וֹ כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וּמְפִיבֹ֗שֶׁת אֹכֵל֙ עַל־ שֻׁלְחָנִ֔י כְּאַחַ֖ד מִבְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ṣî·ḇā ’el- ham·me·leḵ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yə·ṣaw·weh ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dōw kên ya·‘ă·śeh ‘aḇ·de·ḵā ū·mə·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ ’ō·ḵêl ‘al- šul·ḥā·nî kə·’a·ḥaḏ mib·bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And Ziba said to the king Your servant . . . will do . . . all that my lord the king has commanded So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons
verses.literalPt: E disse Ziba ao rei: Conforme a tudo quanto meu senhor, o rei, manda a seu servo, assim fará teu servo. Quanto a Mefibosete, disse o rei, comerá à minha mesa como um dos filhos do rei.

verses.original: וְלִמְפִיבֹ֥שֶׁת בֵּן־ קָטָ֖ן וּשְׁמ֣וֹ מִיכָ֑א וְכֹל֙ מוֹשַׁ֣ב בֵּית־ צִיבָ֔א עֲבָדִ֖ים לִמְפִיבֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lim·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ bên- qā·ṭān ū·šə·mōw mî·ḵā wə·ḵōl mō·wō·šaḇ bêṯ- ṣî·ḇā ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lim·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ
verses.literal: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth
verses.literalPt: E tinha Mefibosete um filho pequeno, cujo nome era Mica; e todos quantos moravam em casa de Ziba eram servos de Mefibosete.

verses.original: וּמְפִיבֹ֗שֶׁת יֹשֵׁב֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ֣י עַל־ שֻׁלְחַ֥ן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ תָּמִ֖יד ה֣וּא אֹכֵ֑ל וְה֥וּא פִסֵּ֖חַ שְׁתֵּ֥י רַגְלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·p̄î·ḇō·šeṯ yō·šêḇ bî·rū·šā·lim kî ‘al- šul·ḥan ham·me·leḵ tā·mîḏ hū ’ō·ḵêl wə·hū pis·sê·aḥ šə·tê raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem because he always ate . . . at the king’s table and he was lame in both feet
verses.literalPt: Morava, pois, Mefibosete em Jerusalém, porquanto sempre comia à mesa do rei, e era coxo de ambos os pés.
